records.quote: vena, ae,/ [perh. root veh-, to carry, 1  etc. ; prop, a pipe, channel ; Gr. oxeror], a '  blood-vessel, vein. I, Lit. I. In gen. : j

note: L&S vena, -ae, f. 释义 "a blood-vessel, vein"，词源写作 "perh. root veh-, to carry; prop. a pipe, channel"，与 vena「血管」一致。

reference.title: A Latin Dictionary (Lewis & Short, 1879)
